notes.title: Introducing World of Ruins, now with portals
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3iSZIDm.jpg[/img]

Divide By Sheep just got a new world, free of charge! Nobody likes paid DLC so we decided to expand the game for free! 

World 5 is titled World of Ruins and concludes the epic story of the Grim Reaper trying to befriend some sheep by killing them. 

New mechanics include:

- Portals. Everything is better with portals. 
- Frying pans with switches. 
- A death totem! 

We also rebalanced the game a little bit, now you can unlock more worlds faster. 

Happy mathing!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Divide By Sheep, 10% off!
notes.content:
Divide By Sheep is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Divide By Sheep is a mind-bending math puzzler about friendship and slicing sheep in half with lasers. The Grim Reaper flooded the world, and it's up to you to save critters stranded on islands. Insane math skills required.

*Offer ends July 9 at 10AM Pacific Time
